incidents.name: Re-callable initialize() then withdrawFees()
incidents.notes: initialize() stayed callable after deployment and overwrote the owner, letting the attacker take control and drain the contract with withdrawFees(address,uint256).

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xd4f1afd0331255e848c119ca39143d41144f7cb3 created 2025-02-13T14:57:37Z by 0x33870422c6e75bd09bf0a408c8d90a5b4cd2c9c4, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xf30be320c55038d7f784c561e56340439dd1a283; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
